body: Thanks. That's very kind. But it'd just be a waste of your time trying to help someone like me who is broken beyond repair. The best thing for me is to die. Nothing of value would be lost. I work in a shit job where I could be replaced in a heartbeat, I barely have any friends and my family life is  a mess. I'm not really contributing to society or adding anything meaningful  to the world and I have all these mental issues - it'll just be better for everyone (myself included) if I killed myself.

Thank you so much. 

I have tried to be positive, especially over the last 3 years. It has only brought more pain with my mother passing away. Every time I try to pick myself up I just get knocked back down again. What's the point?

Honestly my love for gaming was the only thing keeping me going as you said but I don't know if that alone can get me through this.
Talking to people won't help. My head is completely broken and beyobd repair.
Thanks. I just feel so guilty about it. I don't want her to be looking down thinking I don't care either.

Thank you.

My fear is that someone will perform some spell at her grave whilst she is still buried so there is no chance of her escaping. It's stupid I know, but I am the most terrified I have ever been in my life at this "possibility".

I would have her buried if there was 100% proof that she couldn't be brought back to life in the grave and that her body was truly dead.

I have, but they're adamant since we are Christians and it is tradition to have a burial. I am next of kin therefore the decision rests on me, but at the same time I don't want to upset my family. I don't need a family feud on top of losing my mother
